description: Given a media file or folder name, extract the volume designator as a string. A single volume yields its bare number; a hyphenated span yields the span verbatim; decimal volumes are preserved. When no volume marker is present the function returns the loose-leaf sentinel string (-100000). Supports volume keywords across multiple languages.
